chunks: And We sent down from the sky water that was blessed, so We grew with it gardens and grain for the harvest.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the blessed rain mentioned in Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the tangible signs of Allah’s mercy in the natural world, serving as a reminder of the Resurrection just as rain revives dead earth. The mention of 'gardens' (Jannat) and 'grains of harvest' (Hab al-Haseed) underscores the dual blessings of sustenance and beauty, reinforcing the concept of divine provision (Rizq) that extends beyond mere survival to encompass spiritual and physical flourishing.
